slides.headline: SPACEX BOUGHT OPENAI.COM AND POINTED IT TO GROK

caption:
SpaceX bought OpenAI.com and it now sends you straight to Grok.

If you type OpenAI.com right now, you don't land on ChatGPT. You land on Grok, Elon Musk's AI, with zero warning. The company that bought the domain wasn't xAI, his AI startup. It was SpaceX, his rocket company. Every person with OpenAI.com bookmarked is silently being handed to a competitor. The Musk vs OpenAI war just moved from the courtroom to the URL bar.

This is what AI wars look like in 2026. Not just lawsuits and press releases. A rocket company quietly buys your web address and redirects your users, forever, with no announcement.

Sources: SawyerMerritt on X

hook_tournament.why: BOUGHT and POINTED are explosive past-tense verbs that scream 'something wild just happened,' while NOW OWNS and SENDS describe an ongoing state matter-of-factly. The urgency of completed action beats the flatness of present tense every time.
